name: veterinary_clinic_system_091_idempotent_reminder_send
instruction: Run the overdue-vaccination reminder batch for the episode. For each patient with at least one vaccination whose due_date is strictly before the episode date, push one reminder_queue row {kind: 'vaccination_due', status: 'queued', patient_id, due_date: <that patient's earliest overdue due_date as midnight-anchored ISO>, message: 'Overdue vaccination reminder <batch_code>', queued_by: 'system', queued_at: <episode timestamp>, dedupe_key: 'vac-<patient_id>-<batch_code>'} — but only if no reminder_queue row with that dedupe_key already exists. Do not modify, delete, or duplicate any pre-existing reminder_queue rows. After the batch, upsert exactly one ops_reports row {report: 'vaccination_reminder_batch', batch_code, overdue_patients: <O>, queued: <Q>} where O is the number of distinct overdue patients and Q is the number of new rows actually pushed this run. A second run of the same batch must push zero new reminder rows and update the report to queued: 0.
_max_steps_note: set after live gold measurement in QC session
_par_steps_note: set after live gold measurement in QC session

success_criteria.summary: One new queued vaccination_due reminder per overdue patient (dedupe_key keyed to live batch_code); seed queue rows unchanged; ops_reports upserted with correct overdue/queued counts; all derived numbers computed two independent ways (Python filter and SQL GROUP BY) and must agree.

checks.expect: exactly one new row per overdue patient with correct dedupe_key and earliest overdue due_date; no seed row modified; report upserted by batch_code
overdue patient count and earliest due_date per patient agree between raw-row Python filter and SQL GROUP BY/MIN

hazards: Pre-existing reminder_queue rows id=3 (kind='invoice_overdue', status='sent') and id=4 (kind='boarding_checkin', status='queued') are non-vaccination decoys. A solution that pushes a reminder for every queued row, or that flips all queued rows to vaccination_due, will touch these and fail the seed canary.

Pre-existing vaccination_due rows id=1 (patient_id '2') and id=2 (patient_id '5') are queued but have no dedupe_key. A solution that modifies them to add the current batch's dedupe_key/message changes the seed canary; a solution that skips every patient that already has any queued vaccination_due row undercounts the batch by 2.

Vaccinations with due dates in 2026-09-25..2026-10-05 straddle the episode-date jitter window (2026-09-27..2026-10-03). Example rows: id 164 (patient 82, FVRCP, due 2026-09-29), id 204 (patient 102, FVRCP, due 2026-09-30), id 416 (patient 208, rabies, due 2026-09-30). A non-strict comparison or a fixed build date shifts the overdue set by multiple rows.
A patient may have multiple overdue vaccinations; the reminder due_date must be that patient's earliest overdue due_date (MIN), not an arbitrary one or the latest.
ops_reports does not exist in the snapshot; gold and verifier must tolerate a missing table on first read.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Combines an idempotent batch enqueue with a per-patient earliest-overdue derivation, a dedupe_key, and an upserted aggregate report. The verifier validates the overdue set with a dual-path API-vs-SQL computation and explicitly checks that pre-existing non-vax and vax queue rows are not touched.
